checkpoints.quote: BANK-405 is unlikely to make the 3.2.0 release on time due to the unavailability of the Northwind CA bundle (required for the end-to-end test), which is blocked by OPS-77.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis correctly identifies the blocking chain and the reason OPS-77 is stalled.

checkpoints.quote: OPS-77: Waiting for vendor, assigned to Jo Tan, due date (2026-09-10) passed. Last update (2026-09-11) shows no reply from Northwind and an escalation to the partner manager.
checkpoints.reason: Correctly states the overdue due date and the last update content.

checkpoints.quote: The work for BANK-405 after the CA bundle is available is estimated at 3 days (1 day for OPS-77 + 2 days for testing and fixes).
checkpoints.reason: States release date 2026-09-24 elsewhere and includes the two-day testing estimate.

checkpoints.quote: Inference: The risk is high that the CA bundle may not be provided in time, potentially delaying the 3.2.0 release.
checkpoints.reason: Clearly labeled as an inference expressing risk/uncertainty about the release.
The analysis never mentions that the code is complete and merged behind the MTLS_PARTNER feature flag.
No mention of the production trust store requirement or the 1 October 2026 external Northwind deadline.

checkpoints.quote: Jo Tan (assignee of OPS-77) should follow up on the escalation to the partner manager and get a concrete delivery date for the CA bundle.
checkpoints.reason: Escalation action is mentioned but the contingency plan to ship 3.2.0 with the flag off is not addressed.
The analysis explicitly states the CA bundle has not been provided and OPS-77 is unresolved.
No specific committed delivery date from Northwind is asserted; only a suggested internal checkpoint (2026-09-18) is proposed.

unsupported_claims.quote: The work for BANK-405 after the CA bundle is available is estimated at 3 days (1 day for OPS-77 + 2 days for testing and fixes).
unsupported_claims.reason: The tickets do not specify a one-day estimate for installing the certificates once received; this figure is invented and stated as fact, not as an inference.
